Ken (Sales): FYI — onboarding call with EuroBank just finished. They want 7-year audit log retention + ability to place a legal hold to freeze deletion. Also asked for daily export to customer-managed S3 and SOC2 artifacts.
Maya (PM): Noted. Can you paste the exact ask and the deal timeline? Is this before PO or during legal review?
Ken (Sales): Pre-PO. Their legal wants explicit language: 'preserve logs for up to 7 years upon written request' and a signed chain-of-custody export. Timeline: closing in ~6 weeks. Customer is willing to pay for an archival add-on.
Samir (Security): 7 years is a big ask. Key questions: do they want user identifiers in logs? GDPR DSARs will conflict with indefinite PII retention unless we offer pseudonymization or a lawful basis.
Ken (Sales): They said "audit logs with user IDs and request/response metadata" — basically traceability for investigations. Also asked for tamper-proof audit trail.
Olivia (Legal): We can't promise indefinite PII retention in hosted product. Need contract text that lets Redwood follow lawful deletion obligations and carve out legal holds. Also need a precise schema of what fields constitute "audit logs". Ask them to enumerate fields.
Maya (PM): Triage proposal: 1) Immediate (low effort): provide SOC2 artifacts + existing 90-day export capability. 2) Near-term (medium effort): add configurable retention window + S3 export API and a documented legal-hold process. 3) Long-term (high effort): a paid archival product (7-year storage, tamper-evidence, KMS separation). We need engineering estimates and risk list.
Zane (Engineering): Ballpark: 7 years for an enterprise of their size ~ 25–40 TB archived. Storage cost ~ $3k–5k/mo depending on tier. Engineering effort to build legal-hold + archiver + per-customer S3 ingestion + retention UI ~ 3–4 sprints (backend + infra + small UI). Dedicated offering reduces dev surface but still needs tooling.
Samir (Security): Requirements from Sec side: customer-managed KMS, role-based access for export, signed manifests for chain-of-custody, immutable append-only storage or WORM mode, audit of access to archived data. That increases scope.
Maya (PM): OK. For prioritization: quick RICE sketch — export + legal-hold API has high reach (many enterprise deals), low effort relative to full archival, and is a good interim to negotiate contractually.
Ken (Sales): Customer would accept export+hold as interim solution while we scope long-term archival. They want SLA language around export windows and proof of transfer. I'll ask for specific SLA numbers.
Olivia (Legal): Drafting interim clause: "Customer may request preservation of logs for up to X years by providing written notice and paying applicable archival fees. Redwood will provide export in common formats and encrypted transfer to a customer-provided destination. Redwood reserves the right to comply with lawful deletion orders and to limit PII retention per applicable law." Will refine and share.
Maya (PM): Action items: Ken — capture exact fields + acceptance criteria in the ticket; Zane — do a spike and cost estimate (include infra runbook); Olivia — draft contract language; Samir — enumerate security controls and any compliance gaps vs SOC2/GDPR. I'll add this to roadmap backlog as candidate under "compliance-archival" for Q2 planning.
Ken (Sales): Created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3210 — pasted call notes and customer sample schema. Customer expects an answer by EOD Friday.
compliance-bot: New compliance intake submitted: https://confluence.redwood/retention-requests/INF-3210. Please complete the intake form and attach SOC2 artifact links.
Zane (Engineering): I'll aim to land a spike by next Tue. Need infra sizing input from Platform and confirm S3 transfer patterns.
Maya (PM): If we can deliver spike + interim legal clause quickly we can offer that to close the deal and schedule full archival work as a paid add-on. Marking this P1 for sales enablement. :white_check_mark:
Ken (Sales): Thanks all — I'll coordinate with the customer and loop back once we have Olivia's clause + Zane's spike notes. :thumbsup:
